people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?
translations.bsb: But Moses said, “Why are you transgressing the commandment of the LORD? This will not succeed!
translations.kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
translations.asv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of Jehovah, seeing it shall not prosper?
